hypothesised_pattern: The base model underfits a sign-symmetric x4 effect (higher target for larger |x4|), and it also seems to underfit a nonlinear rise in the target when x5 is strongly negative.
functional_form_guess: a*(1 - exp(-x4**2)) plus a saturating decreasing x5 term such as -b*tanh(x5)
rationale: Positive residuals mostly have sizeable |x4| (0.58, -1.10, 1.51, 0.96, 0.83), while two of the negative residuals have x4 near zero (-0.06, 0.29). The positive residual at x4 = 0.01 has x5 = -2.61 (target 0.67), so very negative x5 can raise the target on its own, beyond what the linear base model captures.
